recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, mid-century modern composition featuring a central vertical red rectangle containing minimalist line-art portraits, surrounded by a wide cream-colored border with bold, sans-serif typography and smaller colorful character illustrations at the base.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black line art against a solid red field
Symmetrical typographic blocks flanking a central vertical image
Scale contrast between large minimalist faces and small detailed figures
Balance between expansive cream negative space and a dense central focal point
coreInvariants: Solid red rectangular background for the main illustration
Black ink for all line work and primary text
Minimalist, continuous-line style for the main faces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large minimalist faces occupy the upper two-thirds of a central red rectangle; smaller, colorful figures are clustered at the bottom edge of the rectangle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central red rectangle acts as the primary anchor, drawing the eye to the center of the cream field.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top title, moves down through the large faces, follows the vertical line to the colorful figures at the bottom, then moves outward to the side-aligned names.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive cream-colored margins provide a 'gallery' feel, pushing all visual weight to the center.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Multi-color (Purple, Pink, Yellow, Green) for small figures
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central red block contrasts with the low-saturation cream background; black provides maximum value contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Limit primary background to one solid color block

letterConstructionRules: Slightly flared or irregular terminals to suggest hand-drawn quality
characterSpecificRedesigns: The main title features a slight arch or warp to follow a curved baseline
Side names are strictly vertical and blocky
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and widths to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Filmstrip border for top metadata text

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed, blocky feel of the side text.
The main title has a slight organic irregularity that a standard font might lack.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a minimalist 1960s-style illustration. The background is a flat cream color. In the center is a vertical red rectangle. Inside the rectangle, use black line art to depict two stylized faces in profile, nearly touching. At the bottom of the red rectangle, add small, colorful, sketchy figures of people in theatrical costumes (pinks, purples, yellows). Leave wide cream margins on all sides.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, black, condensed sans-serif text in all caps. Place a large arched title at the top center. Place two blocks of stacked, heavy condensed text on the left and right sides of the central red rectangle. Add a small horizontal line of text at the very top inside a thin filmstrip-style border.

verificationChecks: Is the central rectangle a solid, vibrant red?
Is the background a consistent cream/off-white?
Are the main faces rendered in minimalist black line art?
Is the typography heavy, condensed, and all-caps?
Are the colorful figures at the bottom significantly smaller than the main faces?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the small bottom figures

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the color block

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is overlapping the main line art faces.
Check that the cream background is uniform and not textured like paper unless specified.
Verify that the red rectangle is perfectly centered horizontally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Color] Rectangle + Minimalist [Subject] Line Art + [Condensed Sans-Serif] Flanking Typography + Wide [Neutral] Margins.
